
{{alias}}( n[, options] )
    Returns an initialized one-dimensional workspace ndarray for computing a
    real-valued discrete Fourier transform.

    Parameters
    ----------
    n: integer
        Sequence length.

    options: Object (optional)
        Function options.

    options.dtype: string|DataType (optional)
        Output workspace ndarray data type. Must be a real-valued floating-point
        data type. Default: 'float64'.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( 4 )
    <ndarray>


{{alias}}.assign( workspace, n )
    Initializes a provided one-dimensional workspace ndarray for computing a
    real-valued discrete Fourier transform.

    The function modifies the workspace ndarray in-place and thus mutates the
    input ndarray.

    Parameters
    ----------
    workspace: ndarray
        Workspace ndarray. Must have a real-valued floating-point data type.

    n: integer
        Sequence length.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var ws = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/zeros}}( [ 42 ], { 'dtype': 'float64' } );
    > var out = {{alias}}.assign( ws, 4 )
    <ndarray>
    > var bool = ( out === ws )
    true

    See Also
    --------
